A single hair-thin orange laser filament, <Subject 3>, snaps into existence and streaks across the void at light speed, carving one perfect arc and leaving a glowing molten seam suspended in the air. The camera is an ultra-macro probe hugging the beam itself, flying flat and fast along its path with heavy motion blur and a violent sense of penetration. Along the seam, <Subject 2> begins to well up out of nothing: mercury-like silver beads race along the cut, collide, and fuse into larger flowing volumes, self-assembling like programmable nanomaterial. Sharp specular highlights skim the moving metal while warm orange caustics bend across its meniscus. Sound: a deep sub-bass foundation under a thin, sharp electrical arc hiss that tracks the beam.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the flow decelerates and the silver cools and crystallizes into <Subject 4>, the sculpted numeral "18", its frosted translucent body holding faint orange fiber-optic filaments that pulse like current through a chip. The camera performs one elegant crane orbit, sliding from a side profile onto a high three-quarter angle in a single continuous move, tracing the crisp chamfered geometry and the exact thickness of the carved edges. Sound: a fine granular crackle of liquid setting, layered with a rising high-frequency charge whine that signals stored energy.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, a brilliant white flare refracts upward from the base of the "18". As the glare clears, <Subject 5> materializes at the lower right in thin floating sans-serif letters, and a faint digital raster grid and gravitational ripples shimmer in the background, trembling just enough to imply professional-grade power. The camera snaps into a fast synchronized pull-back, opening the frame at the exact moment the letters resolve so the full "18pro" lockup reads clearly. Sound: one crisp metallic impact, then a wide, airy synth pad that instantly expands the sense of space.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the air directly above the lockup warps into a perfect rounded-rectangle airflow. Inside it, <Subject 6> condenses rapidly from drifting gas particles that shift between bright orange and tech silver, then freeze into a polished 3D glass Mi mark with visible refraction and a warm inner glow. The camera cranes vertically upward with a subtle Z-axis roll, keeping the transition seamless with no visible cut. Sound: a rushing particle whoosh as the mark forms, over a swelling orchestral pad pushing toward the peak.
[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the void resolves into <Subject 7>, a minimal matte deep-grey gradient with a satin finish. <Subject 6> and <Subject 8> settle into perfect centered alignment, the "Xiaomi 18pro" wordmark floating quietly beneath the mark, while a soft band of light glides across the logo's edge and pulls a stunning highlight off the glass. The camera decelerates into an extremely slow micro dolly-back for a calm, premium close. Near the end, the auxiliary line "探索科技，迈向未来" fades in below in ultra-thin type. Sound: every mechanical and electrical layer cuts to silence, leaving one pure, airy bell chime with a long reverberant tail.

overall_soundscape:
A continuous low sub-bass bed and faint high-frequency electrical air persist through the opening shots, punctuated by the laser's cutting hiss, the granular crackle of solidifying liquid metal, a crisp metallic impact, and a rushing particle whoosh; all ambience drops out entirely in the final shot, leaving near-silence around the closing chime.

non_diegetic_music:
